payload.words: A rethink page shows the problem as a picture before section 1

lines.text: A rethink page opens with a block above section 1 that draws the problem in at least one diagram, and the shipped checker refuses a page whose data holds no such diagram
A diagram can show numbers against a limit as bars, and the shipped script draws it
The shipped checker refuses a page whose section 1 holds more than six items besides the impact item

why: Dogfood of hyp-rethinking, 2026-11-28: the rethink of #457 ran on the skill as of 5c1d1756 and wrote two pages, goal-model-check and run-base, with no diagram of the problem and ten items in section 1 each. page-shape.md asks for an event diagram only when its shape matters, the checker accepts none, and a diagram can only be a graph, though #457's problem is numbers: 11,150 and 52,124 states against a chart budget of 500. The owner asked 'Is A means derived state based on git?'. Owner: the picture is a separate block above section 1. Part of #468.
